source.scope: official public train only; no official test used

config.rounding: ceil(N * validation_fraction), capped at N-1; nearest feasible atomic-group count
config.candidate_objective: min(count error, sum((validation label count - requested fraction * full label count)^2 / max(full label count,1)), sorted validation IDs)
config.fact_normalization: lowercase and collapse whitespace on each triple component
config.grouping: connected components of shared normalized facts, duplicate normalized contexts, and near documents

similarity.scope: all public train for partition construction only; future model/retrieval fitting must use split train only

inference_contract: id/context only via inference_documents(); reference triples are used for splitting and evaluation, never exported as inference inputs
